_comment: Two stages. Deterministic rules run first and are exact -- they decide
facts about the data, so they cannot be wrong and cost nothing. The AI
stage only sees pins the deterministic rules could not settle, which is
where real judgement is needed (is this actually about the niche? is it a
Filtering runs against pins already stored locally, so changing anything
here and re-filtering costs no scraping.

deterministic._drop_duplicates: Rule 1. Keyed on pin_url, falling back to title+image_url when the URL is missing.
deterministic._require_title_or_description: Rule 2. Reject only when BOTH are empty; one of the two is enough.
deterministic._drop_listicles: Rule 3. Regex catches a leading count -- '25 Recipes For...', 'Top 10 Best Chicken Dinners', '15+ Easy Ideas'. Anchored near the start so a single recipe containing a number ('Chicken 65') survives. The AI stage catches phrasings the regex misses.
deterministic._min_saves: Reject pins under this many saves. 0 disables. Saves are the strongest popularity signal PinClicks gives.
deterministic._min_pin_score: Reject pins under this pin score. 0 disables.
deterministic._drop_duplicate_titles: Rule 1, second half. Different pin URLs often carry identical content re-pinned by different users -- measured 13 such pairs in a 110-pin set. Pins are ranked by saves before deduplication, so the surviving copy is the best performing one. Set false to keep every distinct pin URL.
deterministic._drop_other_languages: Reject pins whose title AND description are both in another language. A foreign title with an English description is kept, since the description is what gets reused. Uses the same language setting as the keyword filter (config/settings.json -> language_filter.keep).

ai._enabled: Rule 4: niche relevance. Needs an Ollama Cloud API key -- see config/secrets.example.json. With no key, surviving pins are marked 'unreviewed' rather than silently accepted.
ai._reject_non_specific: Drop pins that are food-adjacent but not an actual recipe: food photography, restaurant marketing, kitchen gadgets, diet commentary.

keyword_filters._comment: Level-3 keyword filters, applied before any pins are fetched. Separate from the pin rules above.

sort._comment: How surviving pins are ordered in the review table and the CSV.
sort._by: saves_count | pin_score | position. saves_count is real audience behaviour; pin_score is PinClicks' own metric; position is PinClicks' own ranking (1 = best).
